armor-of-shadows.name: Armor of Shadows
armor-of-shadows.effects.1.name: Armor of Shadows
armor-of-shadows.effects.1.description: You can cast Mage Armor on yourself without expending a spell slot.

eldritch-smite.name: Eldritch Smite
eldritch-smite.effects.0.name: Eldritch Smite
eldritch-smite.effects.0.description: Once per turn, when you hit with your pact weapon, you can expend a Pact Magic spell slot to deal an extra 1d8 Force damage plus 1d8 per level of the slot. You can also knock the target Prone if it is Huge or smaller.

agonizing-blast.name: Agonizing Blast
agonizing-blast.effects.0.name: Agonizing Blast: cantrip
agonizing-blast.effects.1.name: Agonizing Blast
agonizing-blast.effects.1.description: Requires a Warlock cantrip that deals damage. Choose one, and add your Charisma modifier to its damage rolls. Repeatable: choose a different cantrip each time.

repelling-blast.name: Repelling Blast
repelling-blast.effects.0.name: Repelling Blast
repelling-blast.effects.0.description: Requires a Warlock cantrip that deals damage through an attack roll. When you hit a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 feet straight away. Repeatable: choose a different cantrip each time.

lifedrinker.name: Lifedrinker
lifedrinker.effects.0.name: Lifedrinker
lifedrinker.effects.0.description: Once per turn, when you hit with your pact weapon, you deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage, and you can expend one Hit Point Die to regain the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).

gift-of-the-depths.name: Gift of the Depths
gift-of-the-depths.effects.1.name: Gift of the Depths
gift-of-the-depths.effects.1.description: You can breathe underwater and have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. You can also cast Water Breathing once per Long Rest without expending a slot.

gift-of-the-protectors.name: Gift of the Protectors
gift-of-the-protectors.effects.0.name: Gift of the Protectors
gift-of-the-protectors.effects.0.description: A new page appears in your Book of Shadows. With your permission, a creature can write its name on it (up to your Charisma modifier, minimum of one). When a named creature is reduced to 0 HP but not killed, it drops to 1 HP instead. Once triggered, it can't be used again until a Long Rest.

thirsting-blade.name: Thirsting Blade
thirsting-blade.effects.1.name: Thirsting Blade
thirsting-blade.effects.1.description: You gain Extra Attack, but only with your pact weapon: you attack twice with it instead of once when you take the Attack action.

devouring-blade.name: Devouring Blade
devouring-blade.effects.1.name: Devouring Blade
devouring-blade.effects.1.description: Thirsting Blade's Extra Attack grants two extra attacks instead of one.

investment-of-the-chain-master.name: Investment of the Chain Master
investment-of-the-chain-master.effects.0.name: Investment of the Chain Master
investment-of-the-chain-master.effects.0.description: Your familiar gains a Swim or Fly Speed of 40 feet; you can command it to attack as a Bonus Action; its Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage can become Necrotic or Radiant; it uses your spell save DC; and as a Reaction you can give it Resistance to damage it takes.

eldritch-spear.name: Eldritch Spear
eldritch-spear.effects.0.name: Eldritch Spear
eldritch-spear.effects.0.description: Requires a Warlock cantrip that deals damage and has a range of 10 feet or more. Its range increases by 30 feet times your Warlock level. Repeatable: choose a different cantrip each time.

lessons-of-the-first-ones.name: Lessons of the First Ones
lessons-of-the-first-ones.effects.0.name: Lessons of the First Ones
lessons-of-the-first-ones.effects.0.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice. Repeatable: choose a different Origin feat each time. Note which one you took: the catalog doesn't apply it on its own yet.

master-of-myriad-forms.name: Master of Myriad Forms
master-of-myriad-forms.effects.1.name: Master of Myriad Forms
master-of-myriad-forms.effects.1.description: You can cast Alter Self without expending a spell slot.

mask-of-many-faces.name: Mask of Many Faces
mask-of-many-faces.effects.1.name: Mask of Many Faces
mask-of-many-faces.effects.1.description: You can cast Disguise Self without expending a spell slot.

eldritch-mind.name: Eldritch Mind
eldritch-mind.effects.0.name: Eldritch Mind
eldritch-mind.effects.0.description: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration.

gaze-of-two-minds.name: Gaze of Two Minds
gaze-of-two-minds.effects.0.name: Gaze of Two Minds
gaze-of-two-minds.effects.0.description: As a Bonus Action, you touch a willing creature and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn, which you can extend with another Bonus Action. You benefit from its special senses and can cast spells from its space if it is within 60 feet of you.

ascendant-step.name: Ascendant Step

ascendant-step.effects.1.description: You can cast Levitate on yourself without expending a spell slot.

otherworldly-leap.name: Otherworldly Leap
otherworldly-leap.effects.1.name: Otherworldly Leap
otherworldly-leap.effects.1.description: You can cast Jump on yourself without expending a spell slot.

whispers-of-the-grave.name: Whispers of the Grave
whispers-of-the-grave.effects.1.name: Whispers of the Grave
whispers-of-the-grave.effects.1.description: You can cast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.

one-with-shadows.name: One with Shadows
one-with-shadows.effects.1.name: One with Shadows
one-with-shadows.effects.1.description: While you are in Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Invisibility on yourself without expending a spell slot.

fiendish-vigor.name: Fiendish Vigor
fiendish-vigor.effects.1.name: Fiendish Vigor
fiendish-vigor.effects.1.description: You can cast False Life on yourself without expending a spell slot. When cast this way, you don't roll the Temporary Hit Points die: you get the highest number.

witch-sight.name: Witch Sight
witch-sight.effects.0.name: Witch Sight
witch-sight.effects.0.description: You have Truesight with a range of 30 feet.

misty-visions.name: Misty Visions
misty-visions.effects.1.name: Misty Visions
misty-visions.effects.1.description: You can cast Silent Image without expending a spell slot.

visions-of-distant-realms.effects.1.name: Visions of Distant Realms

devils-sight.name: Devil's Sight
devils-sight.effects.1.name: Devil's Sight
devils-sight.effects.1.description: You can see normally in Dim Light and Darkness, both magical and nonmagical, within 120 feet.

pact-of-the-chain.name: Pact of the Chain
pact-of-the-chain.effects.1.name: Pact of the Chain
pact-of-the-chain.effects.2.name: Pact Familiar
pact-of-the-chain.effects.1.description: You learn Find Familiar and can cast it as a Magic action without expending a slot. When you cast it, you choose one of the normal forms or a special one: imp, sprite, sphinx of wonder, skeleton, pseudodragon, quasit, slaad tadpole, or venomous snake. In addition, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your attacks to let your familiar attack with its Reaction.

pact-of-the-blade.name: Pact of the Blade
pact-of-the-blade.effects.0.name: Pact Weapon
pact-of-the-blade.effects.2.name: Pact of the Blade
pact-of-the-blade.effects.2.description: As a Bonus Action, you conjure a Simple or Martial melee pact weapon, or bond with a magic weapon you touch. While the bond lasts, you are proficient with it and can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. When you attack with it, you can use Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls, and make it deal Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage instead of its normal type.

pact-of-the-tome.name: Pact of the Tome
pact-of-the-tome.effects.0.name: Book of Shadows: cantrips
pact-of-the-tome.effects.1.name: Book of Shadows: rituals
pact-of-the-tome.effects.2.name: Pact of the Tome
pact-of-the-tome.effects.2.description: When you finish a rest, you conjure your Book of Shadows. Choose three cantrips and two level 1 spells with the Ritual tag, from any class's list, that you don't already have prepared: while you carry the book, you have them prepared and they count as Warlock spells. The book also serves as a Spellcasting Focus.

savage-attacker.name: Savage Attacker
savage-attacker.effects.0.name: Savage Attacker
savage-attacker.effects.0.description: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon, you can reroll the damage and use the better result.

skilled.name: Skilled
skilled.effects.1.name: Skillful
skilled.effects.1.description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

alert.name: Alert
alert.effects.1.name: Alert
alert.effects.1.description: You add your Proficiency Bonus to your Initiative. You can swap your Initiative with that of a willing ally.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.effects.0.name: Lucky
lucky.effects.0.description: You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can spend them to gain Advantage on a d20 roll or to impose Disadvantage on an attack roll against you.

crafter.name: Crafter
crafter.effects.0.name: Crafter: tools
crafter.effects.1.name: Crafter
crafter.effects.1.description: You gain proficiency with three Artisan's Tools of your choice, get a 20% discount when buying nonmagical items, and can craft faster during a rest.

healer.name: Healer
healer.effects.0.name: Healer
healer.effects.0.description: Battle Medic: with a Healer's Kit, you can expend one use and tend to a creature within 5 feet as a Utilize action. That creature expends one of its Hit Point Dice, and you roll that die: it regains Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Proficiency Bonus. Healing Rerolls: whenever you roll a die to determine the Hit Points you restore with a spell or with Battle Medic, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

musician.name: Musician
musician.effects.0.name: Musician
musician.effects.0.description: You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments. After a rest, you can play to give Heroic Inspiration to allies (up to your Proficiency Bonus).

fs-defense.name: Defense
fs-defense.effects.1.name: Defense
fs-defense.effects.1.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

fs-dueling.name: Dueling
fs-dueling.effects.1.name: Dueling
fs-dueling.effects.1.description: +2 to damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon.

fs-archery.name: Archery
fs-archery.effects.1.name: Archery
fs-archery.effects.1.description: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

fs-great-weapon.name: Great Weapon Fighting
fs-great-weapon.effects.0.name: Great Weapon
fs-great-weapon.effects.0.description: When you roll damage for a melee weapon you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on the damage dice as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property.

great-weapon-master.name: Great Weapon Master
great-weapon-master.effects.1.name: Great Weapon Master
great-weapon-master.effects.1.description: Heavy Weapon Mastery: when you hit a creature with a weapon that has the Heavy property as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can cause the weapon to deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Hew: immediately after you score a Critical Hit with a melee weapon, or reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with one, you can make one attack with the same weapon as a Bonus Action. Hew triggers with any melee weapon, not only Heavy ones.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.effects.1.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.effects.1.description: You ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover, you have no Disadvantage when shooting at long range, and you have no Disadvantage on ranged attacks when an enemy is adjacent to you.

resilient-wisdom.name: Resilient (Wisdom)
resilient-wisdom.effects.2.name: Resilient (Wisdom)
resilient-wisdom.effects.2.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

actor.name: Actor
actor.effects.1.name: Actor
actor.effects.1.description: Advantage on Deception and Performance checks when impersonating someone; you can mimic voices and sounds.

athlete-strength.name: Athlete (Strength)
athlete-strength.effects.1.name: Athlete
athlete-strength.effects.1.description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Standing up from Prone costs only 5 feet of movement, and you can make a running Long or High Jump after moving only 5 feet.

athlete-dexterity.name: Athlete (Dexterity)
athlete-dexterity.effects.1.name: Athlete
athlete-dexterity.effects.1.description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Standing up from Prone costs only 5 feet of movement, and you can make a running Long or High Jump after moving only 5 feet.

charger-strength.name: Charger (Strength)
charger-strength.effects.1.name: Charger
charger-strength.effects.1.description: Improved Dash: when you take the Dash action, your Speed increases by 10 feet for that action. Charge Attack: if you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target immediately before hitting it with a melee attack as part of the Attack action, choose one of these effects: a 1d8 bonus to the attack's damage roll, or push the target up to 10 feet if it is no more than one size larger than you. Only once on each of your turns. (+1 to STR or DEX)

charger-dexterity.name: Charger (Dexterity)
charger-dexterity.effects.1.name: Charger
charger-dexterity.effects.1.description: Improved Dash: when you take the Dash action, your Speed increases by 10 feet for that action. Only once on each of your turns. (+1 to STR or DEX)

chef-constitution.name: Chef (Constitution)
chef-constitution.effects.2.name: Chef
chef-constitution.effects.2.description: Cook's Utensils: you gain proficiency with Cook's Utensils if you don't already have it. Replenishing Meal: as part of a Short Rest, you can cook special food if you have ingredients and Cook's Utensils on hand, enough for 4 + your Proficiency Bonus creatures; at the end of the rest, any creature that eats it and spends at least one Hit Point Die regains an extra 1d8 Hit Points. Bolstering Treats: with 1 hour of work or when you finish a Long Rest, you can cook a number of treats equal to your Proficiency Bonus; they last 8 hours, and a creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

chef-wisdom.name: Chef (Wisdom)
chef-wisdom.effects.2.name: Chef
chef-wisdom.effects.2.description: Cook's Utensils: you gain proficiency with Cook's Utensils if you don't already have it. crusher-strength.name: Crusher (Strength)
crusher-strength.effects.1.name: Crusher
crusher-strength.effects.1.description: When you deal Bludgeoning damage, you can push the target 5 feet; a Bludgeoning Critical Hit grants Advantage on attacks against the target.

crusher-constitution.name: Crusher (Constitution)
crusher-constitution.effects.1.name: Crusher
crusher-constitution.effects.1.description: When you deal Bludgeoning damage, you can push the target 5 feet; a Bludgeoning Critical Hit grants Advantage on attacks against the target.

crossbow-expert.name: Crossbow Expert
crossbow-expert.effects.1.name: Crossbow Expert
crossbow-expert.effects.1.description: Ignore Loading: you ignore the Loading property of the Hand Crossbow, Heavy Crossbow, and Light Crossbow. If you are holding one, you can load ammunition into it even if you lack a free hand. Firing in Melee: being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with crossbows. Dual Wielding: when you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if it is made with a crossbow that has the Light property and you aren't already adding it.

defensive-duelist.name: Defensive Duelist
defensive-duelist.effects.1.name: Defensive Duelist
defensive-duelist.effects.1.description: With a Finesse weapon, as a Reaction you add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC against a melee attack.

dual-wielder-strength.name: Dual Wielder (Strength)
dual-wielder-strength.effects.1.name: Dual Wielder
dual-wielder-strength.effects.1.description: Enhanced Dual Wielding: when you attack with a Light weapon, the extra Bonus Action attack can be made with any melee weapon that lacks the Two-Handed property. Quick Draw: you can draw or stow two weapons without the Two-Handed property when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

dual-wielder-dexterity.name: Dual Wielder (Dexterity)
dual-wielder-dexterity.effects.1.name: Dual Wielder

Quick Draw: you can draw or stow two weapons without the Two-Handed property when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

durable.name: Durable
durable.effects.1.name: Tough
durable.effects.1.description: Defy Death: Advantage on Death Saving Throws. Speedy Recovery: as a Bonus Action, you expend one Hit Point Die and regain the roll.

elemental-adept-intelligence.name: Elemental Adept (Intelligence)
elemental-adept-intelligence.effects.1.name: Elemental Attunement
elemental-adept-intelligence.effects.1.description: Choose a damage type (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder): your spells ignore Resistance to it and treat 1s on the dice as 2s.

heavy-armor-master-constitution.effects.1.name: Heavy Armor Master

keen-mind.effects.2.name: Keen Mind

poisoner-dexterity.effects.2.name: Poisoner
poisoner-dexterity.effects.2.description: Potent Poison: when you make a damage roll that deals Poison damage, it ignores Resistance to Poison damage. Brew Poison: you gain proficiency with the Poisoner's Kit. With 1 hour of work using that kit and expending 50 gp of materials, you create a number of poison doses equal to your Proficiency Bonus. As a Bonus Action, you can apply a dose to a weapon or piece of ammunition; the poison retains its potency for 1 minute or until you deal damage with the poisoned item. When a creature takes damage from that item, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat + your Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d8 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.

shield-master.effects.1.description: Shield Bash: if you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the Attack action and hit with a melee weapon, you can immediately bash the target with your Shield if you have it equipped. The target makes a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) and, on a failure, you either push it 5 feet or give it the Prone condition, your choice. Only once on each of your turns. Interpose Shield: if you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can take a Reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the save and are holding a Shield.

fs-protection.name: Protection
fs-protection.effects.0.name: Protection
fs-protection.effects.0.description: With a Shield, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on an attack against another creature within 5 feet of you, and on the other attacks against it until your next turn while it stays beside you.

fs-thrown-weapon-fighting.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
fs-thrown-weapon-fighting.effects.0.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting

fs-two-weapon-fighting.effects.1.name: Two-Weapon Fighting

fs-unarmed-fighting.name: Unarmed Fighting
fs-unarmed-fighting.effects.0.name: Unarmed Fighting
fs-unarmed-fighting.effects.0.description: Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d6 plus Strength, or 1d8 if you aren't holding weapons or a Shield. At the start of your turn, you can deal 1d4 Bludgeoning damage to a creature you are grappling.

fs-blessed-warrior.name: Blessed Warrior
fs-blessed-warrior.effects.0.name: Blessed Warrior: Cleric cantrips

fs-blessed-warrior.effects.1.description: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Paladin level, you can replace one of those cantrips with another Cleric cantrip. A Paladin can take this option instead of a Fighting Style feat.

fs-druidic-warrior.name: Druidic Warrior
fs-druidic-warrior.effects.0.name: Druidic Warrior: Druid cantrips
fs-druidic-warrior.effects.1.name: Druidic Warrior

Whenever you gain a Ranger level, you can replace one of those cantrips with another Druid cantrip. A Ranger can take this option instead of a Fighting Style feat.

boon-of-fortitude.name: Boon of Fortitude
boon-of-fortitude.effects.2.name: Boon of Fortitude
boon-of-fortitude.effects.2.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 40. Once per turn, when you regain Hit Points, you also regain your Constitution modifier.

boon-of-skill.name: Boon of Skill
boon-of-skill.effects.18.name: Boon of Skill: Expertise
boon-of-skill.effects.20.name: Boon of Skill
boon-of-skill.effects.20.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. You gain proficiency in all skills and Expertise in one skill in which you don't already have it.

boon-of-combat-prowess.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
boon-of-combat-prowess.effects.1.name: Unerring Accuracy
boon-of-combat-prowess.effects.1.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead; you can do so again at the start of your next turn.

boon-of-recovery.name: Boon of Recovery
boon-of-recovery.effects.1.name: Boon of Recovery
boon-of-recovery.effects.1.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Once per Long Rest, when you drop to 0 HP, you drop to 1 instead and regain half your HP maximum. You also have a daily pool of 10d10 that you can spend as a Bonus Action to heal yourself.

boon-of-energy-resistance.name: Boon of Energy Resistance
boon-of-energy-resistance.effects.1.name: Energy Resistances
boon-of-energy-resistance.effects.1.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Choose two Resistances among Acid, Cold, Fire, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, Lightning, Thunder, and Poison; you can change them after a Long Rest. When you take one of those damage types, you can redirect energy with your Reaction.

boon-of-speed.name: Boon of Speed
boon-of-speed.effects.2.name: Boon of Speed
boon-of-speed.effects.2.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Your Speed increases by 30 feet and, as a Bonus Action, you can take the Disengage action and end the Grappled condition on yourself.

boon-of-truesight.name: Boon of Truesight
boon-of-truesight.effects.1.name: True Sight
boon-of-truesight.effects.1.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

boon-of-irresistible-offense.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
boon-of-irresistible-offense.effects.1.name: Unstoppable Attack
boon-of-irresistible-offense.effects.1.description: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 30. Your Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage ignores Resistance. When you roll a 20 on an attack roll, you deal extra damage equal to the increased score.

boon-of-fate.name: Boon of Fate
boon-of-fate.effects.1.name: Improve Fate
boon-of-fate.effects.1.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. After a creature within 60 feet succeeds or fails on a D20 Test, you can add or subtract 2d4. You regain the use when you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

boon-of-the-night-spirit.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
boon-of-the-night-spirit.effects.1.name: Night Spirit
boon-of-the-night-spirit.effects.1.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. In Dim Light or Darkness, you can become Invisible as a Bonus Action until you act, and you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

boon-of-spell-recall.name: Boon of Spell Recall
boon-of-spell-recall.effects.1.name: Free Casting
boon-of-spell-recall.effects.1.description: Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 30. When you cast a spell with a level 1–4 slot, roll 1d4; if it matches the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

boon-of-dimensional-travel.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
boon-of-dimensional-travel.effects.1.name: Beguiling Steps
boon-of-dimensional-travel.effects.1.description: Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Immediately after you take the Attack or Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

aberrant-dragonmark.name: Aberrant Dragonmark
aberrant-dragonmark.effects.0.name: Aberrant Magic: cantrip
aberrant-dragonmark.effects.1.name: Aberrant Magic: level 1 spell
aberrant-dragonmark.effects.2.name: Aberrant Fortitude
aberrant-dragonmark.effects.3.name: Aberrant Magic
aberrant-dragonmark.effects.4.name: Aberrant Surge
aberrant-dragonmark.effects.2.description: When you fail a Constitution saving throw, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d4 and add it to the save, possibly turning it into a success. Once per Long Rest.
aberrant-dragonmark.effects.3.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the Sorcerer spell list. You also choose one level 1 spell from that list: you always have it prepared, can cast it for free once per Short or Long Rest, and can also cast it with slots. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for that spell.
aberrant-dragonmark.effects.4.description: When you cast this feat's level 1 spell, you can expend one Hit Point Die and roll it. On an even number, you gain that many Temporary Hit Points; on an odd number, one creature within 30 feet (not you) takes that much Force damage. If no other creature is in range, you take the damage.

mark-of-detection.name: Mark of Detection
mark-of-detection.effects.3.name: Deductive Intuition
mark-of-detection.effects.4.name: Magic Detection
mark-of-detection.effects.5.name: Mark Spells
mark-of-detection.effects.3.description: When you make an Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) check, you can roll 1d4 and add it to the check.
mark-of-detection.effects.4.description: You always have Detect Magic and Detect Poison and Disease prepared. You can cast each for free once per Long Rest, and also with slots of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you take the feat). At level 3, you add See Invisibility on the same terms.
mark-of-detection.effects.5.description: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, these spells are added to that feature's list. Level 1: Detect Evil and Good, Identify; Level 2: Detect Thoughts, Find Traps; Level 3: Clairvoyance, Nondetection; Level 4: Arcane Eye, Divination; Level 5: Legend Lore.

mark-of-finding.name: Mark of Finding
mark-of-finding.effects.2.name: Hunter's Intuition
mark-of-finding.effects.3.name: Finder's Magic
mark-of-finding.effects.4.name: Mark Spells
mark-of-finding.effects.2.description: When you make a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check, you can roll 1d4 and add it to the check.
mark-of-finding.effects.3.description: You always have Hunter's Mark prepared. You can cast it for free once per Long Rest, and also with slots of the appropriate level.
